    (S : Finset (Option ι)) (hS : S.Nonempty) : ¬ IsSquare (∏ x ∈ S, cmRadicand p x)

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.finrank_adjoin_I_sqrt_primes
decls.doc:
**Degree of a multiquadratic CM field.** For a finite family of distinct primes `p : ι → ℕ`,
the field `ℚ(i, √p₁, …, √pₙ)` generated over `ℚ` by `i` and the real square roots of the `p i`
has degree `2^{|ι|+1}`. This recovers the Erdős CM field `ℚ(i, √q₀, …, √q_{g-1})` as a
multiquadratic field, the worked example of the roadmap.
decls.title: Degree of a multiquadratic CM field
decls.statement:
theorem finrank_adjoin_I_sqrt_primes {ι : Type*} [Finite ι] (p : ι → ℕ)
    (hp : ∀ i, (p i).Prime) (hinj : Function.Injective p) :
    Module.finrank ℚ
        (IntermediateField.adjoin ℚ
          (insert Complex.I (Set.range fun i => ((Real.sqrt (p i) : ℝ) : ℂ))))
      = 2 ^ (Nat.card ι + 1)

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.finrank_adjoin_I_sqrt_two
decls.doc:
**Worked example: `[ℚ(i, √2) : ℚ] = 4`.** The smallest nontrivial multiquadratic CM degree,
obtained from `finrank_adjoin_I_sqrt_primes` with the single prime `2`.
decls.title: Worked example: `[ℚ(i, √2) : ℚ] = 4`
decls.statement:
theorem finrank_adjoin_I_sqrt_two :
    Module.finrank ℚ
      (IntermediateField.adjoin ℚ
        ({Complex.I, ((Real.sqrt 2 : ℝ) : ℂ)} : Set ℂ)) = 4

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.finrank_adjoin_I_sqrt_five
decls.doc:
**Worked example: `[ℚ(i, √5) : ℚ] = 4`.** This is the Layer-0 degree statement for the
multiquadratic field generated by the prime-discriminant radicands `-1` and `5`, the
genus-field generator list for `ℚ(√-5)`.
decls.title: Worked example: `[ℚ(i, √5) : ℚ] = 4`
decls.statement:
theorem finrank_adjoin_I_sqrt_five :
    Module.finrank ℚ
      (IntermediateField.adjoin ℚ
        ({Complex.I, ((Real.sqrt 5 : ℝ) : ℂ)} : Set ℂ)) = 4

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.galoisGroupEquivISqrtPrimes
decls.doc:
**The Galois group of a multiquadratic CM field is `(ℤ/2)^{n+1}`.** For a finite family of
distinct primes `p : ι → ℕ`, the field `ℚ(i, √p₁, …, √pₙ)` generated over `ℚ` by `i` and the real
square roots of the `p i` has Galois group isomorphic to `Multiplicative (Option ι → ℤ/2)`. This
is the `Option`-indexed corollary of the field-generic isomorphism `galoisGroupEquiv`.
decls.title: The Galois group of a multiquadratic CM field is `(ℤ/2)^{n+1}`

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.galoisGroupEquivISqrtPrimes_apply
decls.doc:
The CM Galois equivalence sends an automorphism to its sign pattern on the generators
`i, √(p i)`.
decls.statement:
theorem galoisGroupEquivISqrtPrimes_apply
    (σ : adjoin ℚ (Set.range (cmRoot p)) ≃ₐ[ℚ] adjoin ℚ (Set.range (cmRoot p))) :
    galoisGroupEquivISqrtPrimes p hp hinj σ =
      Multiplicative.ofAdd (signPattern (cmRoot p) σ)

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.galoisGroupEquivISqrtPrimes_symm_apply_gen
decls.doc:
The inverse CM Galois equivalence realizes a sign pattern by sending each generator to
`(-1)^(ε x)` times itself: `i ↦ ±i` and `√(p i) ↦ ±√(p i)`.
decls.statement:
theorem galoisGroupEquivISqrtPrimes_symm_apply_gen (ε : Option ι → ZMod 2)
    (x : Option ι) :
    ((galoisGroupEquivISqrtPrimes p hp hinj).symm (Multiplicative.ofAdd ε)) (gen (cmRoot p) x)
      = (-1) ^ (ε x).val * gen (cmRoot p) x

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.card_aut_adjoin_I_sqrt_primes
decls.doc:
**Cardinality of the Galois group of a multiquadratic CM field.** For a finite family of
distinct primes `p : ι → ℕ`, `|Gal(ℚ(i, √p₁, …, √pₙ)/ℚ)| = 2^{|ι|+1}`. This is the cardinality
reading of `galoisGroupEquivISqrtPrimes`, matching the CM degree `finrank_adjoin_I_sqrt_primes`.
decls.title: Cardinality of the Galois group of a multiquadratic CM field
decls.statement:
theorem card_aut_adjoin_I_sqrt_primes :
    Nat.card
        ((adjoin ℚ (insert Complex.I (Set.range fun i => ((Real.sqrt (p i) : ℝ) : ℂ))) :
            IntermediateField ℚ ℂ) ≃ₐ[ℚ]
          (adjoin ℚ (insert Complex.I (Set.range fun i => ((Real.sqrt (p i) : ℝ) : ℂ))) :
            IntermediateField ℚ ℂ))
      = 2 ^ (Nat.card ι + 1)

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.card_aut_adjoin_I_sqrt_two
decls.doc:
**Worked example: `|Gal(ℚ(i, √2)/ℚ)| = 4`.** The one-real-prime worked example,
obtained from `card_aut_adjoin_I_sqrt_primes` with the single prime `2`.
decls.title: Worked example: `|Gal(ℚ(i, √2)/ℚ)| = 4`
decls.statement:
theorem card_aut_adjoin_I_sqrt_two :
    Nat.card
        ((adjoin ℚ ({Complex.I, ((Real.sqrt 2 : ℝ) : ℂ)} : Set ℂ) : IntermediateField ℚ ℂ) ≃ₐ[ℚ]
          (adjoin ℚ ({Complex.I, ((Real.sqrt 2 : ℝ) : ℂ)} : Set ℂ) : IntermediateField ℚ ℂ))
      = 4

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.genusPrimeDiscriminants
decls.doc:
The chosen prime-discriminant factorization of `fundamentalDiscriminant d`: for squarefree `d`,
the finite set of prime discriminants dividing the discriminant of `ℚ(√d)`, from
`IsFundamentalDiscriminant.exists_finset_primeDiscriminant`.
decls.statement: def genusPrimeDiscriminants {d : ℤ} (hd : Squarefree d) : Finset ℤ

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.genusPrimeDiscriminants_spec
decls.doc:
The defining properties of `genusPrimeDiscriminants`: its members are prime discriminants, at
most one of which is even, and their product is `fundamentalDiscriminant d`.
decls.statement:
theorem genusPrimeDiscriminants_spec {d : ℤ} (hd : Squarefree d) :
    (∀ P ∈ genusPrimeDiscriminants hd, IsPrimeDiscriminant P) ∧
      (∀ P ∈ genusPrimeDiscriminants hd, ∀ Q ∈ genusPrimeDiscriminants hd,
        IsEvenPrimeDiscriminant P → IsEvenPrimeDiscriminant Q → P = Q) ∧
      ∏ P ∈ genusPrimeDiscriminants hd, P = fundamentalDiscriminant d

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.genusFieldRoot
decls.doc:
A chosen complex square root of the radicand of each prime discriminant in
`genusPrimeDiscriminants hd` (available since `ℂ` is algebraically closed).
decls.statement:
def genusFieldRoot {d : ℤ} (hd : Squarefree d)
    (P : {P // P ∈ genusPrimeDiscriminants hd}) : ℂ

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.genusFieldRoot_sq
decls.doc: Each `genusFieldRoot` squares to its radicand (in `ℂ`-cast normal form).
decls.statement:
theorem genusFieldRoot_sq {d : ℤ} (hd : Squarefree d)
    (P : {P // P ∈ genusPrimeDiscriminants hd}) :
    genusFieldRoot hd P ^ 2 = ((primeDiscriminantRadicand P.val : ℤ) : ℂ)

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.candidateGenusField
decls.doc:
**The candidate genus field of `ℚ(√d)`.** For squarefree `d`, the compositum over `ℚ` of the
chosen complex square roots of the radicands of the prime discriminants dividing
`fundamentalDiscriminant d`. Unramified at the finite places, it is the genus field of `ℚ(√d)` for
imaginary `d` and only the narrow candidate for real `d`; identifying it with the genus field
unramified at all places (the infinite ones included) is later work.
decls.title: The candidate genus field of `ℚ(√d)`
decls.statement: def candidateGenusField {d : ℤ} (hd : Squarefree d) : IntermediateField ℚ ℂ

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.candidateGenusField_def
decls.doc: `candidateGenusField` presented as the `adjoin` of its chosen roots.
decls.statement:
theorem candidateGenusField_def {d : ℤ} (hd : Squarefree d) :
    candidateGenusField hd = adjoin ℚ (Set.range (genusFieldRoot hd))

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.genusFieldRoot_mem_candidateGenusField
decls.doc: Each chosen root lies in the candidate genus field.
decls.statement:
theorem genusFieldRoot_mem_candidateGenusField {d : ℤ} (hd : Squarefree d)
    (P : {P // P ∈ genusPrimeDiscriminants hd}) :
    genusFieldRoot hd P ∈ candidateGenusField hd

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.candidateGenusField_le_iff
decls.doc:
**Universal property of the candidate genus field.** It is contained in an intermediate field
`F` exactly when `F` contains every chosen root.
decls.title: Universal property of the candidate genus field
decls.statement:
theorem candidateGenusField_le_iff {d : ℤ} (hd : Squarefree d) {F : IntermediateField ℚ ℂ} :
    candidateGenusField hd ≤ F ↔ ∀ P, genusFieldRoot hd P ∈ F

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.exists_mem_candidateGenusField_sq_eq
decls.doc:
**The candidate genus field of `ℚ(√d)` contains a square root of `d`.** This is what makes it a
candidate genus field *of `ℚ(√d)`*; it specializes the square-class containment of `GenusField` to
the chosen factorization and roots.
decls.title: The candidate genus field of `ℚ(√d)` contains a square root of `d`
decls.statement:
theorem exists_mem_candidateGenusField_sq_eq {d : ℤ} (hd : Squarefree d) :
    ∃ x ∈ candidateGenusField hd, x ^ 2 = algebraMap ℚ ℂ ((d : ℤ) : ℚ)

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.finiteDimensional_candidateGenusField
decls.doc: The candidate genus field is finite-dimensional over `ℚ`.
decls.statement:
instance finiteDimensional_candidateGenusField {d : ℤ} {hd : Squarefree d} :
    FiniteDimensional ℚ (candidateGenusField hd)

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.finrank_candidateGenusField
decls.doc:
**Degree of the candidate genus field.** If `d` is squarefree, adjoining the chosen square
roots of the radicands of the prime discriminants in `genusPrimeDiscriminants hd` gives an
extension of `ℚ` of degree `2 ^ (genusPrimeDiscriminants hd).card`. Thus the candidate genus
field has the full degree predicted by square-class independence.
decls.title: Degree of the candidate genus field
decls.statement:
theorem finrank_candidateGenusField {d : ℤ} (hd : Squarefree d) :
    Module.finrank ℚ (candidateGenusField hd) =
      2 ^ (genusPrimeDiscriminants hd).card

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.candidateGenusFieldEquivAdjoin
decls.statement:
def candidateGenusFieldEquivAdjoin {d : ℤ} (hd : Squarefree d) :
    candidateGenusField hd ≃ₐ[ℚ] adjoin ℚ (Set.range (genusFieldRoot hd))

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.genusFieldRoot_sq_algebraMap
decls.statement:
theorem genusFieldRoot_sq_algebraMap {d : ℤ} (hd : Squarefree d)
    (P : {P // P ∈ genusPrimeDiscriminants hd}) :
    genusFieldRoot hd P ^ 2 =
      algebraMap ℚ ℂ (((primeDiscriminantRadicand P.val : ℤ) : ℚ))

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.genusPrimeDiscriminants_not_all_three_even
decls.statement:
theorem genusPrimeDiscriminants_not_all_three_even {d : ℤ} (hd : Squarefree d) :
    ¬ ((∃ P : {P // P ∈ genusPrimeDiscriminants hd}, P.val = -4) ∧
      (∃ P : {P // P ∈ genusPrimeDiscriminants hd}, P.val = 8) ∧
        (∃ P : {P // P ∈ genusPrimeDiscriminants hd}, P.val = -8))

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.candidateGenusFieldGen
decls.doc: The chosen root indexed by `P`, regarded as an element of the candidate genus field.
decls.statement:
def candidateGenusFieldGen {d : ℤ} (hd : Squarefree d)
    (P : {P // P ∈ genusPrimeDiscriminants hd}) : candidateGenusField hd

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.candidateGenusFieldGen_sq
decls.doc: The chosen candidate-genus-field generator squares to its prime-discriminant radicand.
decls.statement:
theorem candidateGenusFieldGen_sq {d : ℤ} (hd : Squarefree d)
    (P : {P // P ∈ genusPrimeDiscriminants hd}) :
    candidateGenusFieldGen hd P ^ 2 =
      algebraMap ℚ (candidateGenusField hd)
        (((primeDiscriminantRadicand P.val : ℤ) : ℚ))

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.candidateGenusFieldEquivAdjoin_apply_gen
decls.statement:
theorem candidateGenusFieldEquivAdjoin_apply_gen {d : ℤ} (hd : Squarefree d)
    (P : {P // P ∈ genusPrimeDiscriminants hd}) :
    candidateGenusFieldEquivAdjoin hd (candidateGenusFieldGen hd P) =
      gen (genusFieldRoot hd) P

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.candidateGenusField_autCongr_fixes_gen_iff
decls.statement:
theorem candidateGenusField_autCongr_fixes_gen_iff {d : ℤ} (hd : Squarefree d)
    (σ : candidateGenusField hd ≃ₐ[ℚ] candidateGenusField hd)
    (P : {P // P ∈ genusPrimeDiscriminants hd}) :
    (AlgEquiv.autCongr (candidateGenusFieldEquivAdjoin hd) σ)
          (gen (genusFieldRoot hd) P) = gen (genusFieldRoot hd) P ↔
      σ (candidateGenusFieldGen hd P) = candidateGenusFieldGen hd P

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.candidateGenusFieldSignPattern
decls.doc:
The sign pattern of an automorphism of the candidate genus field, obtained by transporting
the automorphism to the presentation generated by `genusFieldRoot` and recording its action on
each chosen root.

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.candidateGenusFieldSignPattern_apply
decls.doc:
The sign recorded at `P` is zero exactly when the automorphism fixes the corresponding
chosen generator.
decls.statement:
theorem candidateGenusFieldSignPattern_apply {d : ℤ} (hd : Squarefree d)
    (σ : candidateGenusField hd ≃ₐ[ℚ] candidateGenusField hd)
    (P : {P // P ∈ genusPrimeDiscriminants hd}) :
    candidateGenusFieldSignPattern hd σ P =
      if σ (candidateGenusFieldGen hd P) = candidateGenusFieldGen hd P then 0 else 1

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.galoisGroupEquivCandidateGenusField
decls.doc:
**The Galois group of the candidate genus field is the group of sign patterns.** An
automorphism is sent to the function recording whether it fixes or negates each chosen
prime-discriminant root. Square-class independence makes this map bijective.
decls.title: The Galois group of the candidate genus field is the group of sign patterns

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.galoisGroupEquivCandidateGenusField_apply
decls.doc:
The candidate-genus-field Galois equivalence sends an automorphism to its sign pattern on the
chosen prime-discriminant roots.
decls.statement:
theorem galoisGroupEquivCandidateGenusField_apply {d : ℤ} (hd : Squarefree d)
    (σ : candidateGenusField hd ≃ₐ[ℚ] candidateGenusField hd) :
    galoisGroupEquivCandidateGenusField hd σ =
      Multiplicative.ofAdd (candidateGenusFieldSignPattern hd σ)

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.galoisGroupEquivCandidateGenusField_symm_apply_gen
decls.doc:
The inverse candidate-genus-field Galois equivalence realizes a sign pattern by sending each
chosen generator to `(-1)^(ε P)` times that generator.
decls.statement:
theorem galoisGroupEquivCandidateGenusField_symm_apply_gen {d : ℤ}
    (hd : Squarefree d) (ε : {P // P ∈ genusPrimeDiscriminants hd} → ZMod 2)
    (P : {P // P ∈ genusPrimeDiscriminants hd}) :
    ((galoisGroupEquivCandidateGenusField hd).symm (Multiplicative.ofAdd ε))
        (candidateGenusFieldGen hd P) =
      (-1) ^ (ε P).val * candidateGenusFieldGen hd P

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.isAbelianGalois_candidateGenusField
decls.doc:
**The candidate genus field is abelian Galois over `ℚ`.** It is generated by square roots of
rational elements, so the field-generic multiquadratic abelian-Galois theorem applies.
decls.title: The candidate genus field is abelian Galois over `ℚ`
decls.statement:
instance isAbelianGalois_candidateGenusField {d : ℤ} {hd : Squarefree d} :
    IsAbelianGalois ℚ (candidateGenusField hd)

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.card_aut_candidateGenusField
decls.doc:
**Cardinality of the candidate-genus-field Galois group.** Its order is `2` to the number of
prime discriminants in the chosen factorization of `fundamentalDiscriminant d`.
decls.title: Cardinality of the candidate-genus-field Galois group
decls.statement:
theorem card_aut_candidateGenusField {d : ℤ} (hd : Squarefree d) :
    Nat.card (candidateGenusField hd ≃ₐ[ℚ] candidateGenusField hd) =
      2 ^ (genusPrimeDiscriminants hd).card

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.candidateGenusFieldBaseRoot
decls.doc:
A chosen square root of `d` inside its candidate genus field. Existence follows from the
prime-discriminant factorization of `fundamentalDiscriminant d`; no particular sign is selected.
decls.statement:
def candidateGenusFieldBaseRoot {d : ℤ} (hd : Squarefree d) :
    candidateGenusField hd

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.candidateGenusFieldBaseRoot_sq
decls.doc: The chosen base root squares to `d`.
decls.statement:
theorem candidateGenusFieldBaseRoot_sq {d : ℤ} (hd : Squarefree d) :
    candidateGenusFieldBaseRoot hd ^ 2 =
      algebraMap ℚ (candidateGenusField hd) ((d : ℤ) : ℚ)

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.candidateGenusFieldBase
decls.doc:
The copy of `ℚ(√d)` inside `candidateGenusField hd`, generated by the chosen square root
of `d`. It is quadratic exactly in the nonsquare case used for quadratic fields.
decls.statement:
def candidateGenusFieldBase {d : ℤ} (hd : Squarefree d) :
    IntermediateField ℚ (candidateGenusField hd)

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.candidateGenusFieldBase_def
decls.doc: `candidateGenusFieldBase` presented as the simple extension generated by its chosen root.
decls.statement:
theorem candidateGenusFieldBase_def {d : ℤ} (hd : Squarefree d) :
    candidateGenusFieldBase hd = adjoin ℚ {candidateGenusFieldBaseRoot hd}

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.candidateGenusFieldBaseRoot_mem
decls.doc: The chosen square root of `d` lies in the quadratic base.
decls.statement:
theorem candidateGenusFieldBaseRoot_mem {d : ℤ} (hd : Squarefree d) :
    candidateGenusFieldBaseRoot hd ∈ candidateGenusFieldBase hd

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.candidateGenusFieldBase_le_iff
decls.doc:
**Universal property of the quadratic base.** It lies below an intermediate field `F`
exactly when `F` contains the chosen square root of `d`.
decls.title: Universal property of the quadratic base
decls.statement:
theorem candidateGenusFieldBase_le_iff {d : ℤ} (hd : Squarefree d)
    {F : IntermediateField ℚ (candidateGenusField hd)} :
    candidateGenusFieldBase hd ≤ F ↔ candidateGenusFieldBaseRoot hd ∈ F

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.finrank_candidateGenusFieldBase
decls.doc:
**The embedded base `ℚ(√d)` is quadratic.** If `d` is not a square in `ℚ`, the simple
subfield generated by the chosen square root of `d` has degree two over `ℚ`.
decls.title: The embedded base `ℚ(√d)` is quadratic
decls.statement:
theorem finrank_candidateGenusFieldBase {d : ℤ} (hd : Squarefree d)
    (hnsq : ¬ IsSquare (((d : ℤ) : ℚ))) :
    Module.finrank ℚ (candidateGenusFieldBase hd) = 2

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.finrank_candidateGenusField_over_candidateGenusFieldBase
decls.doc:
**Relative degree of the candidate genus field over `ℚ(√d)`.** If the squarefree integer
`d` is not a rational square, the prime-discriminant compositum has degree
`2 ^ (t - 1)` over its embedded quadratic base, where
`t = (genusPrimeDiscriminants hd).card`.
decls.title: Relative degree of the candidate genus field over `ℚ(√d)`
decls.statement:
theorem finrank_candidateGenusField_over_candidateGenusFieldBase {d : ℤ} (hd : Squarefree d)
    (hnsq : ¬ IsSquare (((d : ℤ) : ℚ))) :
    Module.finrank (candidateGenusFieldBase hd) (candidateGenusField hd) =
      2 ^ ((genusPrimeDiscriminants hd).card - 1)

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.not_isSquare_prod_of_coprime_squarefree
decls.doc:
**Square-class independence of pairwise coprime squarefree integers.** If the radicands `d i`
are pairwise coprime, each squarefree, and each a non-unit, then no nonempty subset product
`∏_{i ∈ S} d i` is a square in `ℤ`. This generalises `not_isSquare_prod_primes` (the distinct-primes
case) to the squarefree integers the genus theory uses, and supplies the square-class independence
the multiquadratic degree theorem `finrank_adjoin_range` consumes.
decls.title: Square-class independence of pairwise coprime squarefree integers
decls.statement:
theorem not_isSquare_prod_of_coprime_squarefree {ι : Type*} (d : ι → ℤ) {S : Finset ι}
    (hcop : (S : Set ι).Pairwise (IsCoprime on d)) (hsf : ∀ i ∈ S, Squarefree (d i))
    (hnu : ∀ i ∈ S, ¬ IsUnit (d i)) (hS : S.Nonempty) :
    ¬ IsSquare (∏ i ∈ S, d i)

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.not_isSquare_prod_of_coprime_squarefree_rat
decls.doc:
**Square-class independence cast to `ℚ`.** If `d : ι → ℤ` is pairwise coprime with each entry
squarefree and a non-unit, then no nonempty subset product `∏_{i ∈ S} (d i : ℚ)` is a square in
`ℚ`. This is the `∀ S` shape of `hindep` the degree and Galois-group theorems consume directly.
decls.title: Square-class independence cast to `ℚ`
decls.statement:
theorem not_isSquare_prod_of_coprime_squarefree_rat {ι : Type*} (d : ι → ℤ)
    (hcop : Pairwise (IsCoprime on d)) (hsf : ∀ i, Squarefree (d i)) (hnu : ∀ i, ¬ IsUnit (d i)) :
    ∀ S : Finset ι, S.Nonempty → ¬ IsSquare (∏ i ∈ S, (d i : ℚ))

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.finrank_adjoin_range_of_coprime_squarefree
decls.doc:
**Degree of a multiquadratic field with squarefree integer radicands.** If `d : ι → ℤ` is
pairwise coprime with each entry squarefree and a non-unit, and `root i` is a square root of `d i`
in a field `L` over `ℚ` (so `ℚ(√d₁, …, √dₙ)` makes sense even for the negative radicands the genus
theory needs), then `[ℚ(rootᵢ : i) : ℚ] = 2^|ι|`. This is the squarefree-integer corollary of the
field-generic degree theorem `finrank_adjoin_range`.
decls.title: Degree of a multiquadratic field with squarefree integer radicands
decls.statement:
theorem finrank_adjoin_range_of_coprime_squarefree {ι : Type*} [Finite ι] {L : Type*} [Field L]
    [Algebra ℚ L] (d : ι → ℤ) (root : ι → L) (hroot : ∀ i, root i ^ 2 = algebraMap ℚ L (d i))
    (hcop : Pairwise (IsCoprime on d)) (hsf : ∀ i, Squarefree (d i)) (hnu : ∀ i, ¬ IsUnit (d i)) :
    Module.finrank ℚ (IntermediateField.adjoin ℚ (Set.range root)) = 2 ^ Nat.card ι

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.finrank_adjoin_sqrt_six_thirtyfive
decls.doc:
**Worked example: `[ℚ(√6, √35) : ℚ] = 4`.** The radicands `6 = 2·3` and `35 = 5·7` are
composite, so this lies beyond the distinct-primes corollary `finrank_adjoin_sqrt_primes`; it is
covered by `finrank_adjoin_range_of_coprime_squarefree` because `6` and `35` are coprime,
squarefree, and not units.
decls.title: Worked example: `[ℚ(√6, √35) : ℚ] = 4`
decls.statement:
theorem finrank_adjoin_sqrt_six_thirtyfive :
    Module.finrank ℚ
      (IntermediateField.adjoin ℚ {Real.sqrt 6, Real.sqrt 35} : IntermediateField ℚ ℝ) = 4

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.finrank_sqrtTower
decls.doc:
**Degree of a multiquadratic tower.** If no nonempty subset product of the radicands `d j`
(`j < n`) is a square in `K`, then `[K(root₀, …, rootₙ₋₁) : K] = 2ⁿ`.
decls.title: Degree of a multiquadratic tower
decls.statement:
theorem finrank_sqrtTower {d : ℕ → K} {root : ℕ → L}
    (hroot : ∀ j, root j ^ 2 = algebraMap K L (d j)) [NeZero (2 : K)] :
    ∀ n, (∀ S : Finset ℕ, S.Nonempty → ↑S ⊆ Set.Iio n → ¬ IsSquare (∏ j ∈ S, d j)) →
      Module.finrank K (sqrtTower (K := K) root n) = 2 ^ n

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.finrank_adjoin_range
decls.doc:
**Degree of a multiquadratic field over a finite index.** If no nonempty subset product of
the radicands `d i` is a square in `K`, then `[K(rootᵢ : i) : K] = 2^|ι|`.
decls.title: Degree of a multiquadratic field over a finite index
decls.statement:
theorem finrank_adjoin_range {ι : Type*} [Finite ι] {d : ι → K} {root : ι → L}
    (hroot : ∀ i, root i ^ 2 = algebraMap K L (d i)) [NeZero (2 : K)]
    (hindep : ∀ S : Finset ι, S.Nonempty → ¬ IsSquare (∏ i ∈ S, d i)) :
    Module.finrank K (IntermediateField.adjoin K (Set.range root)) = 2 ^ Nat.card ι

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.IsEvenPrimeDiscriminant
decls.doc: The three even prime discriminants: `-4`, `8`, and `-8`.
decls.statement: def IsEvenPrimeDiscriminant (D : ℤ) : Prop

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.isEvenPrimeDiscriminant_iff
decls.doc: The defining disjunction for `IsEvenPrimeDiscriminant`.
decls.statement:
theorem isEvenPrimeDiscriminant_iff {D : ℤ} :
    IsEvenPrimeDiscriminant D ↔ D = -4 ∨ D = 8 ∨ D = -8

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.isEvenPrimeDiscriminant_neg_four
decls.statement:
theorem isEvenPrimeDiscriminant_neg_four :
    IsEvenPrimeDiscriminant (-4)

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.isEvenPrimeDiscriminant_eight
decls.statement:
theorem isEvenPrimeDiscriminant_eight :
    IsEvenPrimeDiscriminant 8

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.isEvenPrimeDiscriminant_neg_eight
decls.statement:
theorem isEvenPrimeDiscriminant_neg_eight :
    IsEvenPrimeDiscriminant (-8)

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.evenPrimeDiscriminantRadicand
decls.doc:
The squarefree radicand associated to an even prime discriminant. For `D = -4, 8, -8`
this gives respectively `-1, 2, -2`.
decls.statement: def evenPrimeDiscriminantRadicand (D : ℤ) : ℤ

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.evenPrimeDiscriminantRadicand_neg_four
decls.statement:
theorem evenPrimeDiscriminantRadicand_neg_four :
    evenPrimeDiscriminantRadicand (-4) = -1

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.evenPrimeDiscriminantRadicand_eight
decls.statement:
theorem evenPrimeDiscriminantRadicand_eight :
    evenPrimeDiscriminantRadicand 8 = 2

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.evenPrimeDiscriminantRadicand_neg_eight
decls.statement:
theorem evenPrimeDiscriminantRadicand_neg_eight :
    evenPrimeDiscriminantRadicand (-8) = -2

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.evenPrimeDiscriminant_eq_four_mul_radicand
decls.doc: An even prime discriminant is four times its associated squarefree radicand.

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.evenPrimeDiscriminantRadicand_eq_neg_one_or_eq_two_or_eq_neg_two
decls.doc:
The associated squarefree radicand of an even prime discriminant is one of `-1`, `2`,
or `-2`.
decls.statement:
theorem evenPrimeDiscriminantRadicand_eq_neg_one_or_eq_two_or_eq_neg_two {D : ℤ}
    (hD : IsEvenPrimeDiscriminant D) :
    evenPrimeDiscriminantRadicand D = -1 ∨
      evenPrimeDiscriminantRadicand D = 2 ∨
        evenPrimeDiscriminantRadicand D = -2

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.evenPrimeDiscriminantRadicand_natAbs_eq_one_or_two
decls.doc: The absolute value of the radicand attached to an even prime discriminant is `1` or `2`.
decls.statement:
theorem evenPrimeDiscriminantRadicand_natAbs_eq_one_or_two {D : ℤ}
    (hD : IsEvenPrimeDiscriminant D) :
    (evenPrimeDiscriminantRadicand D).natAbs = 1 ∨
      (evenPrimeDiscriminantRadicand D).natAbs = 2

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.evenPrimeDiscriminantRadicand_ne_zero
decls.doc: The radicand attached to an even prime discriminant is nonzero.

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.squarefree_evenPrimeDiscriminantRadicand
decls.doc: The radicand attached to an even prime discriminant is squarefree.

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.two_dvd_evenPrimeDiscriminant
decls.doc: The even prime discriminants themselves are even.

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.evenPrimeDiscriminantRadicand_mod_four_eq_three_or_two
decls.doc:
The radicand attached to an even prime discriminant is congruent to `-1` or `2`
modulo `4`.
decls.statement:
theorem evenPrimeDiscriminantRadicand_mod_four_eq_three_or_two {D : ℤ}
    (hD : IsEvenPrimeDiscriminant D) :
    evenPrimeDiscriminantRadicand D % 4 = 3 ∨
      evenPrimeDiscriminantRadicand D % 4 = 2

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.not_isSquare_evenPrimeDiscriminantRadicand_rat
decls.doc: The rational radicand associated to an even prime discriminant is not a square.

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.evenPrimeDiscriminantRadicand_eq_neg_one_iff
decls.doc: The discriminant `-4` gives the radicand `-1`.

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.evenPrimeDiscriminantRadicand_eq_two_iff
decls.doc: The discriminant `8` gives the radicand `2`.

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.evenPrimeDiscriminantRadicand_eq_neg_two_iff
decls.doc: The discriminant `-8` gives the radicand `-2`.

decls.name: TauCeti.NumberField.isArithFrobAt_multiquadratic_eq_one_iff
decls.doc:
**A multiquadratic Frobenius is trivial iff every radicand is a residue.** Let
`K = ℚ(√d₁, …, √dₙ)` be generated over `ℚ` by the square roots `r i` of the integers `d i`,
let `p` be an odd prime with `p ∤ d i` for all `i`, and let `σ` be an arithmetic Frobenius at
an ideal `Q` of `𝓞 K` above `p`. Then `σ = 1` iff every `d i` is a quadratic residue mod `p`.
Combined with the splitting law, this is the Frobenius-theoretic reading of complete
splitting.
decls.title: A multiquadratic Frobenius is trivial iff every radicand is a residue
decls.statement:
theorem isArithFrobAt_multiquadratic_eq_one_iff (d : ι → ℤ) (r : ι → K)
    (hr : ∀ i, r i ^ 2 = algebraMap ℤ K (d i))
    (htop : IntermediateField.adjoin ℚ (Set.range r) = ⊤)
    (hodd : p ≠ 2) (hcop : ∀ i, ¬ (p : ℤ) ∣ d i)
    (Q : Ideal (𝓞 K)) [Q.LiesOver (span {(p : ℤ)})]
    {σ : K ≃ₐ[ℚ] K} (hσ : IsArithFrobAt ℤ σ Q) :
    σ = 1 ↔ ∀ i, legendreSym p (d i) = 1

decls.name: TauCeti.NumberField.exists_isArithFrobAt_multiquadratic
decls.doc:
**The Frobenius of a multiquadratic field acts on each generator by a Legendre symbol.**
For a Galois number field `K` with elements `r i` satisfying `r i ² = d i ∈ ℤ`, an odd prime
`p` with `p ∤ d i` for all `i`, and any prime `Q` of `𝓞 K` above `p`, there is an arithmetic
Frobenius `σ ∈ Gal(K/ℚ)` at `Q`, and it sends each generator to the corresponding Legendre
multiple: `σ (r i) = legendreSym p (d i) • r i`. This is the generator-wise Frobenius input of
the multiquadratic splitting law; the sign-vector description under `galoisGroupEquiv` is not
formed here (see the module docstring). The `IsGalois ℚ K` hypothesis holds in particular when
the `r i` generate `K` (`TauCeti.Multiquadratic.isGalois` transported along `adjoin ℚ … = ⊤`).
decls.title: The Frobenius of a multiquadratic field acts on each generator by a Legendre symbol
decls.statement:
theorem exists_isArithFrobAt_multiquadratic [IsGalois ℚ K] (d : ι → ℤ) (r : ι → K)
    (hr : ∀ i, r i ^ 2 = algebraMap ℤ K (d i))
    (hodd : p ≠ 2) (hcop : ∀ i, ¬ (p : ℤ) ∣ d i)
    (Q : Ideal (𝓞 K)) [Q.IsPrime] [Q.LiesOver (span {(p : ℤ)})] :
    ∃ σ : K ≃ₐ[ℚ] K, IsArithFrobAt ℤ σ Q ∧
      ∀ i, σ (r i) = legendreSym p (d i) • r i

decls.name: TauCeti.NumberField.algebraRatAdjoinRange
decls.doc: The rational algebra structure on the multiquadratic intermediate field.
decls.statement:
instance algebraRatAdjoinRange :
    Algebra ℚ ↥(IntermediateField.adjoin ℚ (Set.range root))

decls.name: TauCeti.NumberField.root_sq_algebraMap_rat
decls.doc:
The integer defining equation `root i ² = d i` recast with base field `ℚ`. Only characteristic
zero is needed (for the `ℤ → ℚ → L` scalar tower).

decls.name: TauCeti.NumberField.signPattern_frobenius
decls.doc:
**The Frobenius sign pattern of a multiquadratic field is the Legendre encoding.** For the
multiquadratic field `M = ℚ(√dᵢ : i) = adjoin ℚ (Set.range root)`, an odd prime `p ∤ dᵢ`, and an
arithmetic Frobenius `σ` on `M` at a prime `Q` above `p`, the `i`-th coordinate of the sign
pattern is `0` when `dᵢ` is a quadratic residue mod `p` and `1` otherwise.
decls.title: The Frobenius sign pattern of a multiquadratic field is the Legendre encoding
decls.statement:
theorem signPattern_frobenius (hroot : ∀ i, root i ^ 2 = algebraMap ℤ L (d i))
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (hodd : p ≠ 2) (hcop : ∀ i, ¬ (p : ℤ) ∣ d i)
    (Q : Ideal (𝓞 ↥(IntermediateField.adjoin ℚ (Set.range root))))
    [Q.LiesOver (span {(p : ℤ)})]
    {σ : ↥(IntermediateField.adjoin ℚ (Set.range root)) ≃ₐ[ℚ]
        ↥(IntermediateField.adjoin ℚ (Set.range root))}
    (hσ : IsArithFrobAt ℤ σ Q) (i : ι) :
    signPattern root σ i = if legendreSym p (d i) = 1 then 0 else 1

decls.name: TauCeti.NumberField.galoisGroupEquiv_frobenius
decls.doc:
**The Frobenius of a multiquadratic field is the Legendre sign vector.** Under square-class
independence of the `dᵢ` (so `TauCeti.Multiquadratic.galoisGroupEquiv` is the identification
`Gal(M/ℚ) ≅ (ℤ/2)ⁿ`), an arithmetic Frobenius `σ` at a prime `Q` above the odd prime `p ∤ dᵢ`
maps to the vector of Legendre symbols `i ↦ (dᵢ/p)`. This is the roadmap's Layer 1 Frobenius
statement.
decls.title: The Frobenius of a multiquadratic field is the Legendre sign vector
decls.statement:
theorem galoisGroupEquiv_frobenius [Finite ι]
    (hroot : ∀ i, root i ^ 2 = algebraMap ℤ L (d i))
    (hindep : ∀ S : Finset ι, S.Nonempty → ¬ IsSquare (∏ i ∈ S, (d i : ℚ)))
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (hodd : p ≠ 2) (hcop : ∀ i, ¬ (p : ℤ) ∣ d i)
    (Q : Ideal (𝓞 ↥(IntermediateField.adjoin ℚ (Set.range root))))
    [Q.LiesOver (span {(p : ℤ)})]
    {σ : ↥(IntermediateField.adjoin ℚ (Set.range root)) ≃ₐ[ℚ]
        ↥(IntermediateField.adjoin ℚ (Set.range root))}
    (hσ : IsArithFrobAt ℤ σ Q) :
    galoisGroupEquiv
        (fun i => by rw [hroot i, IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply ℤ ℚ L]; simp) hindep σ =
      Multiplicative.ofAdd (fun i => if legendreSym p (d i) = 1 then 0 else 1)

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.IsFundamentalDiscriminant
decls.doc:
A **fundamental discriminant**: either `D ≡ 1 (mod 4)` with `D` squarefree, or `D = 4 * m`
with `m` squarefree and `m ≡ 2` or `3 (mod 4)`. These are the discriminants of quadratic fields,
together with `1`.
decls.statement: def IsFundamentalDiscriminant (D : ℤ) : Prop

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.isFundamentalDiscriminant_iff
decls.doc: The defining disjunction for `IsFundamentalDiscriminant`.
decls.statement:
theorem isFundamentalDiscriminant_iff {D : ℤ} :
    IsFundamentalDiscriminant D ↔
      (D % 4 = 1 ∧ Squarefree D) ∨
        ∃ m : ℤ, D = 4 * m ∧ (m % 4 = 2 ∨ m % 4 = 3) ∧ Squarefree m

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.isFundamentalDiscriminant_one
decls.doc:
The discriminant of `ℚ` itself. It is the empty product of prime discriminants, and the
degenerate case of the first branch of the definition.
decls.statement: theorem isFundamentalDiscriminant_one : IsFundamentalDiscriminant 1

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.IsFundamentalDiscriminant.ne_zero
decls.doc: A fundamental discriminant is nonzero.
decls.statement: theorem IsFundamentalDiscriminant.ne_zero {D : ℤ} (hD : IsFundamentalDiscriminant D) : D ≠ 0

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.IsFundamentalDiscriminant.mod_four_eq_zero_or_one
decls.doc: A fundamental discriminant is `0` or `1` modulo `4`.
decls.statement:
theorem IsFundamentalDiscriminant.mod_four_eq_zero_or_one {D : ℤ}
    (hD : IsFundamentalDiscriminant D) : D % 4 = 0 ∨ D % 4 = 1

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.IsFundamentalDiscriminant.squarefree_of_mod_four_eq_one
decls.doc: The first branch accessor: a fundamental discriminant that is `1` modulo `4` is squarefree.
decls.statement:
theorem IsFundamentalDiscriminant.squarefree_of_mod_four_eq_one {D : ℤ}
    (hD : IsFundamentalDiscriminant D) (h : D % 4 = 1) : Squarefree D

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.IsFundamentalDiscriminant.squarefree_div_four
decls.doc:
The second branch accessor: for a fundamental discriminant divisible by `4`, the quotient
`D / 4` is squarefree.
decls.statement:
theorem IsFundamentalDiscriminant.squarefree_div_four {D : ℤ}
    (hD : IsFundamentalDiscriminant D) (h : D % 4 = 0) : Squarefree (D / 4)

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.IsFundamentalDiscriminant.div_four_mod_four_eq_two_or_three
decls.doc:
The second branch accessor: for a fundamental discriminant divisible by `4`, the quotient
`D / 4` is `2` or `3` modulo `4`.
decls.statement:
theorem IsFundamentalDiscriminant.div_four_mod_four_eq_two_or_three {D : ℤ}
    (hD : IsFundamentalDiscriminant D) (h : D % 4 = 0) : D / 4 % 4 = 2 ∨ D / 4 % 4 = 3

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.IsPrimeDiscriminant.isFundamentalDiscriminant
decls.doc:
Every prime discriminant is a fundamental discriminant: the odd ones land in the first branch
of the definition, the even ones `-4, 8, -8` in the second, with radicands `-1, 2, -2`.
decls.statement:
theorem IsPrimeDiscriminant.isFundamentalDiscriminant {D : ℤ} (hD : IsPrimeDiscriminant D) :
    IsFundamentalDiscriminant D

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.IsPrimeDiscriminant.not_isUnit
decls.doc: A prime discriminant is not a unit: its absolute value is `4`, `8`, or an odd prime.
decls.statement:
theorem IsPrimeDiscriminant.not_isUnit {D : ℤ} (hD : IsPrimeDiscriminant D) :
    ¬ IsUnit D

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.eq_oddPrimeDiscriminant_natAbs
decls.doc:
A prime discriminant that is not even is `oddPrimeDiscriminant` of its (odd, prime) absolute
value.
decls.statement:
theorem eq_oddPrimeDiscriminant_natAbs {D : ℤ} (hD : IsPrimeDiscriminant D)
    (hev : ¬ IsEvenPrimeDiscriminant D) :
    (D.natAbs).Prime ∧ Odd D.natAbs ∧ D = oddPrimeDiscriminant D.natAbs

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.prod_oddPrimeDiscriminant_mod_four_eq_one
decls.doc:
A product of odd prime discriminants is congruent to `1` modulo `4`. No distinctness of the
underlying primes is needed.
decls.statement:
theorem prod_oddPrimeDiscriminant_mod_four_eq_one (hodd : ∀ i ∈ s, Odd (p i)) :
    (∏ i ∈ s, oddPrimeDiscriminant (p i)) % 4 = 1

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.odd_prod_oddPrimeDiscriminant
decls.doc: A product of odd prime discriminants is odd.
decls.statement:
theorem odd_prod_oddPrimeDiscriminant (hodd : ∀ i ∈ s, Odd (p i)) :
    Odd (∏ i ∈ s, oddPrimeDiscriminant (p i))

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.squarefree_prod_oddPrimeDiscriminant
decls.doc: A product of odd prime discriminants at pairwise distinct primes is squarefree.
decls.statement:
theorem squarefree_prod_oddPrimeDiscriminant (hp : ∀ i ∈ s, (p i).Prime)
    (hinj : Set.InjOn p s) :
    Squarefree (∏ i ∈ s, oddPrimeDiscriminant (p i))

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.isFundamentalDiscriminant_prod_oddPrimeDiscriminant
decls.doc:
**A product of odd prime discriminants is a fundamental discriminant**, provided the
underlying odd primes are pairwise distinct. The empty product recovers
`isFundamentalDiscriminant_one`.
decls.title: A product of odd prime discriminants is a fundamental discriminant
decls.statement:
theorem isFundamentalDiscriminant_prod_oddPrimeDiscriminant (hp : ∀ i ∈ s, (p i).Prime)
    (hodd : ∀ i ∈ s, Odd (p i)) (hinj : Set.InjOn p s) :
    IsFundamentalDiscriminant (∏ i ∈ s, oddPrimeDiscriminant (p i))

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.isFundamentalDiscriminant_mul_prod_oddPrimeDiscriminant_of_isEvenPrimeDiscriminant
decls.doc:
**An even prime discriminant times a product of odd prime discriminants is a fundamental
discriminant**, provided the underlying odd primes are pairwise distinct. Together with
`isFundamentalDiscriminant_prod_oddPrimeDiscriminant` this covers every product of pairwise
coprime prime discriminants, since two even prime discriminants are never coprime; see
`isFundamentalDiscriminant_prod` for the assembled statement.
decls.statement:
theorem isFundamentalDiscriminant_mul_prod_oddPrimeDiscriminant_of_isEvenPrimeDiscriminant {e : ℤ}
    (he : IsEvenPrimeDiscriminant e) (hp : ∀ i ∈ s, (p i).Prime) (hodd : ∀ i ∈ s, Odd (p i))
    (hinj : Set.InjOn p s) :
    IsFundamentalDiscriminant (e * ∏ i ∈ s, oddPrimeDiscriminant (p i))

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.prod_oddPrimeDiscriminant_natAbs_of_not_isEvenPrimeDiscriminant
decls.doc:
The shared normalisation step of `isFundamentalDiscriminant_prod`: over a set `t` of prime
discriminants, none of them even and with pairwise distinct values, each `D i` is
`oddPrimeDiscriminant` of an odd prime, that odd-prime map is injective on `t`, and the product
rewrites as a product of odd prime discriminants. Applied to both branches of the case split.
decls.statement:
theorem prod_oddPrimeDiscriminant_natAbs_of_not_isEvenPrimeDiscriminant {D : ι → ℤ}
    {t : Finset ι} (hD : ∀ i ∈ t, IsPrimeDiscriminant (D i))
    (hev : ∀ i ∈ t, ¬ IsEvenPrimeDiscriminant (D i)) (hDinj : Set.InjOn D t) :
    (∀ i ∈ t, ((D i).natAbs).Prime) ∧ (∀ i ∈ t, Odd (D i).natAbs) ∧
      Set.InjOn (fun i => (D i).natAbs) t ∧
      ∏ i ∈ t, D i = ∏ i ∈ t, oddPrimeDiscriminant (D i).natAbs

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.isFundamentalDiscriminant_prod
decls.doc:
**A product of distinct prime discriminants with at most one even value is a fundamental
discriminant.**
decls.statement:
theorem isFundamentalDiscriminant_prod {D : ι → ℤ} (hD : ∀ i ∈ s, IsPrimeDiscriminant (D i))
    (hDinj : Set.InjOn D s)
    (heven : ∀ i ∈ s, ∀ j ∈ s, IsEvenPrimeDiscriminant (D i) →
      IsEvenPrimeDiscriminant (D j) → D i = D j) :
    IsFundamentalDiscriminant (∏ i ∈ s, D i)

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.isFundamentalDiscriminant_prod_of_pairwise_isCoprime
decls.doc: A product of pairwise coprime prime discriminants is a fundamental discriminant.
decls.statement:
theorem isFundamentalDiscriminant_prod_of_pairwise_isCoprime {D : ι → ℤ}
    (hD : ∀ i ∈ s, IsPrimeDiscriminant (D i))
    (hcop : ∀ i ∈ s, ∀ j ∈ s, i ≠ j → IsCoprime (D i) (D j)) :
    IsFundamentalDiscriminant (∏ i ∈ s, D i)

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.IsFundamentalDiscriminant.not_isSquare_rat
decls.doc:
A fundamental discriminant other than `1` is not a rational square. Consequently `ℚ(√D)` is a
genuine quadratic field: this is what keeps the genus-field constructions non-degenerate.
decls.statement:
theorem IsFundamentalDiscriminant.not_isSquare_rat {D : ℤ} (hD : IsFundamentalDiscriminant D)
    (h1 : D ≠ 1) : ¬ IsSquare ((D : ℤ) : ℚ)

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.isFundamentalDiscriminant_neg_twenty
decls.doc:
**Worked example.** `-20`, the discriminant of `ℚ(√-5)`, is a fundamental discriminant: it is
the product of the prime discriminants `-4` and `5`, whose square roots generate the genus field
`ℚ(√-1, √5)`.
decls.title: Worked example
decls.statement: theorem isFundamentalDiscriminant_neg_twenty : IsFundamentalDiscriminant (-20)

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.isFundamentalDiscriminant_neg_eighty_four
decls.doc:
**Worked example.** `-84`, the discriminant of `ℚ(√-21)`, is a fundamental discriminant: it is
the product of the prime discriminants `-4`, `-3` and `-7`, whose square roots generate the genus
field `ℚ(√-1, √-3, √-7)`.
decls.title: Worked example
decls.statement: theorem isFundamentalDiscriminant_neg_eighty_four : IsFundamentalDiscriminant (-84)

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.eq_of_natAbs_eq_of_mod_four_eq_one
decls.doc:
Sign uniqueness modulo `4`: two integers with the same absolute value that are both
`≡ 1 (mod 4)` are equal (they cannot be negatives of each other).
decls.statement:
lemma eq_of_natAbs_eq_of_mod_four_eq_one {x y : ℤ} (h : x.natAbs = y.natAbs)
    (hx : x % 4 = 1) (hy : y % 4 = 1) : x = y

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.prod_oddPrimeDiscriminant_primeFactors_eq
decls.doc:
**The odd prime discriminants recover the odd `≡ 1 (mod 4)` part.** For an odd squarefree
integer `x ≡ 1 (mod 4)`, the product of the odd prime discriminants `p*` over the prime factors
`p` of `x` equals `x`.
decls.title: The odd prime discriminants recover the odd `≡ 1 (mod 4)` part
decls.statement:
lemma prod_oddPrimeDiscriminant_primeFactors_eq {x : ℤ} (hsf : Squarefree x)
    (hodd : Odd x) (hmod : x % 4 = 1) :
    ∏ p ∈ x.natAbs.primeFactors, oddPrimeDiscriminant p = x

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.oddPrimeDiscriminant_image_prod
decls.doc:
The image family `{p* : p ∣ n}` of odd prime discriminants over the prime factors of an odd
`n`: each member is a non-even prime discriminant, and the assignment is injective, so its `Finset`
product is the indexed product over the prime factors.
decls.statement:
lemma oddPrimeDiscriminant_image_prod {n : ℕ} (hn : Odd n) :
    (∀ P ∈ n.primeFactors.image oddPrimeDiscriminant, IsPrimeDiscriminant P ∧
        ¬ IsEvenPrimeDiscriminant P) ∧
      ∏ P ∈ n.primeFactors.image oddPrimeDiscriminant, P =
        ∏ p ∈ n.primeFactors, oddPrimeDiscriminant p

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.exists_finset_insert_evenPrimeDiscriminant
decls.doc:
Prepend one even prime discriminant `e` to the odd-prime-discriminant image family of an odd
`n`, packaged as a finset of prime discriminants with `e` the unique even member and product `D`.
This is the shared body of the three even-discriminant branches of the main theorem.
decls.statement:
lemma exists_finset_insert_evenPrimeDiscriminant {D e : ℤ} {n : ℕ} (hn : Odd n)
    (hePD : IsPrimeDiscriminant e) (heE : IsEvenPrimeDiscriminant e)
    (hprod : e * ∏ p ∈ n.primeFactors, oddPrimeDiscriminant p = D) :
    ∃ s : Finset ℤ, (∀ P ∈ s, IsPrimeDiscriminant P) ∧
      (∀ P ∈ s, ∀ Q ∈ s, IsEvenPrimeDiscriminant P → IsEvenPrimeDiscriminant Q → P = Q) ∧
      ∏ P ∈ s, P = D

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.IsFundamentalDiscriminant.exists_finset_primeDiscriminant
decls.doc:
**Analysis half of the prime-discriminant correspondence.** Every fundamental discriminant
`D` is a product of a finite set of prime discriminants, at most one of which is even. This is the
converse of `TauCeti.Multiquadratic.isFundamentalDiscriminant_prod`.
decls.title: Analysis half of the prime-discriminant correspondence
decls.statement:
theorem IsFundamentalDiscriminant.exists_finset_primeDiscriminant {D : ℤ}
    (hD : IsFundamentalDiscriminant D) :
    ∃ s : Finset ℤ, (∀ P ∈ s, IsPrimeDiscriminant P) ∧
      (∀ P ∈ s, ∀ Q ∈ s, IsEvenPrimeDiscriminant P → IsEvenPrimeDiscriminant Q → P = Q) ∧
      ∏ P ∈ s, P = D

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.fundamentalDiscriminant
decls.doc:
The **fundamental discriminant** attached to an integer `d`: the discriminant of the quadratic
field `ℚ(√d)` for squarefree `d`, namely `d` when `d ≡ 1 (mod 4)` and `4 * d` otherwise.
decls.statement: def fundamentalDiscriminant (d : ℤ) : ℤ

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.fundamentalDiscriminant_of_mod_four_eq_one
decls.statement:
theorem fundamentalDiscriminant_of_mod_four_eq_one {d : ℤ} (hd : d % 4 = 1) :
    fundamentalDiscriminant d = d

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.fundamentalDiscriminant_of_mod_four_ne_one
decls.statement:
theorem fundamentalDiscriminant_of_mod_four_ne_one {d : ℤ} (hd : d % 4 ≠ 1) :
    fundamentalDiscriminant d = 4 * d

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.fundamentalDiscriminant_def
decls.statement:
theorem fundamentalDiscriminant_def (d : ℤ) :
    fundamentalDiscriminant d = if d % 4 = 1 then d else 4 * d

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.fundamentalDiscriminant_eq_self_or_four_mul
decls.doc:
`fundamentalDiscriminant d` is `d` or `4 * d`. Implementation helper for
`exists_sq_mul_eq_fundamentalDiscriminant`.
decls.statement:
theorem fundamentalDiscriminant_eq_self_or_four_mul (d : ℤ) :
    fundamentalDiscriminant d = d ∨ fundamentalDiscriminant d = 4 * d

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.exists_sq_mul_eq_fundamentalDiscriminant
decls.doc:
`c² * d = fundamentalDiscriminant d` for some `c ∈ {1, 2}`: the fundamental discriminant
differs from `d` by a nonzero square, so `ℚ(√(fundamentalDiscriminant d)) = ℚ(√d)`. The
`c = 1 ∨ c = 2` restriction is part of the statement, so the multiplier is genuinely a
unit-or-`2` square (not the vacuous `c = 0`).
decls.statement:
theorem exists_sq_mul_eq_fundamentalDiscriminant (d : ℤ) :
    ∃ c : ℤ, (c = 1 ∨ c = 2) ∧ c ^ 2 * d = fundamentalDiscriminant d

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.isFundamentalDiscriminant_fundamentalDiscriminant
decls.doc:
**The fundamental discriminant of a squarefree integer is a fundamental discriminant.** When
`d ≡ 1 (mod 4)` the value is `d` itself (`≡ 1 (mod 4)`, squarefree); otherwise `d ≡ 2` or
`3 (mod 4)` (it cannot be `0 (mod 4)`, as `4 = 2²` would break squarefreeness) and the value is
`4 * d`.
decls.title: The fundamental discriminant of a squarefree integer is a fundamental discriminant
decls.statement:
theorem isFundamentalDiscriminant_fundamentalDiscriminant {d : ℤ} (hd : Squarefree d) :
    IsFundamentalDiscriminant (fundamentalDiscriminant d)

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.definingPolynomial
decls.doc: The defining polynomial of the multiquadratic field: `∏ᵢ (X² - dᵢ)`.
decls.statement: def definingPolynomial (d : ι → K) : K[X]

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.definingPolynomial_def
decls.doc: The defining polynomial is the product of the quadratic factors `X² - dᵢ`.
decls.statement:
theorem definingPolynomial_def :
    definingPolynomial d = (letI := Fintype.ofFinite ι; ∏ i, (X ^ 2 - C (d i)))

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.splits_X_sq_sub_C
decls.doc: Each quadratic factor splits in `M`, with roots `± rootᵢ`.
decls.statement:
theorem splits_X_sq_sub_C (hroot : ∀ i, root i ^ 2 = algebraMap K L (d i)) (i : ι) :
    ((X ^ 2 - C (d i)).map (algebraMap K (adjoin K (Set.range root)))).Splits

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.gen
decls.doc: The `i`-th generator, as an element of the multiquadratic field `M`.
decls.statement: def gen (root : ι → L) (i : ι) : adjoin K (Set.range root)

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.coe_gen
decls.doc: Coercing the `i`-th generator of `K(rootᵢ : i)` back to `L` gives `root i`.
decls.statement: theorem coe_gen (i : ι) : (gen (K := K) root i : L) = root i

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.adjoin_gen_eq_top
decls.doc: The generators generate `M` as its own top field.
decls.statement:
theorem adjoin_gen_eq_top :
    IntermediateField.adjoin K (Set.range (gen (K := K) root)) = ⊤

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.gen_sq
decls.doc: The generator squares to its radicand (in `M`).
decls.statement:
theorem gen_sq (hroot : ∀ i, root i ^ 2 = algebraMap K L (d i)) (i : ι) :
    gen (K := K) root i ^ 2 = algebraMap K (adjoin K (Set.range root)) (d i)

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.aut_gen_eq_self_or_eq_neg
decls.doc: Every automorphism sends a generator to itself or to its negation.
decls.statement:
theorem aut_gen_eq_self_or_eq_neg (hroot : ∀ i, root i ^ 2 = algebraMap K L (d i))
    (σ : adjoin K (Set.range root) ≃ₐ[K] adjoin K (Set.range root)) (i : ι) :
    σ (gen root i) = gen root i ∨ σ (gen root i) = -gen root i

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.gen_ne_neg
decls.doc:
A generator is not equal to its own negation when the radicand is nonzero, since `2 ≠ 0` in
`L` (via `Ring.eq_self_iff_eq_zero_of_char_ne_two`).
decls.statement:
theorem gen_ne_neg [NeZero (2 : K)] (hroot : ∀ i, root i ^ 2 = algebraMap K L (d i))
    (i : ι) (hd : d i ≠ 0) :
    gen (K := K) root i ≠ -gen root i

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.definingPolynomial_ne_zero
decls.doc: `∏ᵢ (X² - dᵢ)` is nonzero.
decls.statement: theorem definingPolynomial_ne_zero : definingPolynomial d ≠ 0

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.splits_definingPolynomial
decls.doc: The defining polynomial splits over `M`.
decls.statement:
theorem splits_definingPolynomial (hroot : ∀ i, root i ^ 2 = algebraMap K L (d i)) :
    ((definingPolynomial d).map (algebraMap K (adjoin K (Set.range root)))).Splits

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.isAlgebraic_gen
decls.doc: Each generator is algebraic over `K` (it satisfies `X² - dᵢ`).
decls.statement:
theorem isAlgebraic_gen (hroot : ∀ i, root i ^ 2 = algebraMap K L (d i)) (i : ι) :
    IsAlgebraic K (gen (K := K) root i)

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.isSplittingField
decls.doc: `M = K(rootᵢ : i)` is the splitting field of `∏ᵢ (X² - dᵢ)` over `K`.
decls.statement:
theorem isSplittingField (hroot : ∀ i, root i ^ 2 = algebraMap K L (d i)) :
    (definingPolynomial d).IsSplittingField K (adjoin K (Set.range root))

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.isGalois
decls.doc:
A multiquadratic field over a field in which `2 ≠ 0` is Galois: it is the splitting field of
`∏ᵢ (X² - dᵢ)` (hence normal), and each generator satisfies a separable quadratic.
decls.statement:
theorem isGalois [NeZero (2 : K)] (hroot : ∀ i, root i ^ 2 = algebraMap K L (d i)) :
    IsGalois K (adjoin K (Set.range root))

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.aut_mul_self_eq_one
decls.doc:
Every `K`-automorphism of the multiquadratic field `K(rootᵢ : i)` is an involution: fixing
`K` forces the image of each generator to have the same square as the generator, so applying the
automorphism twice fixes the generators.
decls.statement:
theorem aut_mul_self_eq_one (hroot : ∀ i, root i ^ 2 = algebraMap K L (d i))
    (σ : IntermediateField.adjoin K (Set.range root) ≃ₐ[K]
      IntermediateField.adjoin K (Set.range root)) :
    σ * σ = 1

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.aut_commute
decls.doc:
The automorphism group of a multiquadratic field is commutative: every element has order
dividing two, so any two commute.
decls.statement:
theorem aut_commute (hroot : ∀ i, root i ^ 2 = algebraMap K L (d i))
    (a b : IntermediateField.adjoin K (Set.range root) ≃ₐ[K]
      IntermediateField.adjoin K (Set.range root)) :
    Commute a b

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.isAbelianGalois
decls.doc: A finite multiquadratic extension in characteristic different from two is abelian Galois.
decls.statement:
theorem isAbelianGalois [Finite ι] [NeZero (2 : K)]
    (hroot : ∀ i, root i ^ 2 = algebraMap K L (d i)) :
    IsAbelianGalois K (IntermediateField.adjoin K (Set.range root))

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.aut_exponent_dvd_two
decls.doc: **The Galois group of a multiquadratic field has exponent dividing two.**
decls.title: The Galois group of a multiquadratic field has exponent dividing two
decls.statement:
theorem aut_exponent_dvd_two (hroot : ∀ i, root i ^ 2 = algebraMap K L (d i)) :
    Monoid.exponent (adjoin K (Set.range root) ≃ₐ[K] adjoin K (Set.range root)) ∣ 2

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.aut_exponent_eq_two_of_nontrivial
decls.doc: **A nontrivial multiquadratic Galois group has exponent exactly two.**
decls.title: A nontrivial multiquadratic Galois group has exponent exactly two
decls.statement:
theorem aut_exponent_eq_two_of_nontrivial
    [Nontrivial (adjoin K (Set.range root) ≃ₐ[K] adjoin K (Set.range root))]
    (hroot : ∀ i, root i ^ 2 = algebraMap K L (d i)) :
    Monoid.exponent (adjoin K (Set.range root) ≃ₐ[K] adjoin K (Set.range root)) = 2

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.aut_exponent_eq_two
decls.doc: **The Galois group of a nonempty family of independent radicands has exponent exactly two.**
decls.title: The Galois group of a nonempty family of independent radicands has exponent exactly two
decls.statement:
theorem aut_exponent_eq_two [Finite ι] [NeZero (2 : K)] [Nonempty ι]
    (hroot : ∀ i, root i ^ 2 = algebraMap K L (d i))
    (hindep : ∀ S : Finset ι, S.Nonempty → ¬ IsSquare (∏ i ∈ S, d i)) :
    Monoid.exponent (adjoin K (Set.range root) ≃ₐ[K] adjoin K (Set.range root)) = 2

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.signPattern
decls.doc:
The sign pattern of an automorphism: `0` where it fixes a generator and `1` otherwise.
When `gen root i ≠ -gen root i`, the `1` case says that the automorphism negates the generator.
decls.statement:
def signPattern
    (σ : adjoin K (Set.range root) ≃ₐ[K] adjoin K (Set.range root)) (i : ι) : ZMod 2

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.aut_gen_eq_signPattern
decls.doc: An automorphism acts on each generator by the corresponding sign.
decls.statement:
theorem aut_gen_eq_signPattern (hroot : ∀ i, root i ^ 2 = algebraMap K L (d i))
    (σ : adjoin K (Set.range root) ≃ₐ[K] adjoin K (Set.range root)) (i : ι) :
    σ (gen root i) = (-1) ^ (signPattern root σ i).val * gen root i

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.signPattern_eq_ite_of_zsmul_gen
decls.doc:
**Read the sign pattern off a generator-wise sign.** If `σ (gen root i) = ε • gen root i`
with `ε = ±1` (in `ℤ`) and `d i ≠ 0`, then `signPattern root σ i` is `0` when `ε = 1` and `1`
when `ε = -1`. This bridges a generator-wise sign — for instance a Frobenius acting on `√dᵢ` by
a Legendre symbol (`TauCeti.NumberField.isArithFrobAt_apply_sqrt`) — to the `(ℤ/2)ⁿ`
identification, so it composes with `TauCeti.Multiquadratic.galoisGroupEquiv_apply`.
decls.title: Read the sign pattern off a generator-wise sign
decls.statement:
theorem signPattern_eq_ite_of_zsmul_gen [NeZero (2 : K)]
    (hroot : ∀ i, root i ^ 2 = algebraMap K L (d i))
    (σ : adjoin K (Set.range root) ≃ₐ[K] adjoin K (Set.range root)) {i : ι} {ε : ℤ}
    (hε : ε = 1 ∨ ε = -1) (hd : d i ≠ 0) (hσ : σ (gen root i) = ε • gen root i) :
    signPattern root σ i = if ε = 1 then 0 else 1

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.signPattern_injective
decls.doc: Two automorphisms with the same sign pattern are equal.
decls.statement:
theorem signPattern_injective (hroot : ∀ i, root i ^ 2 = algebraMap K L (d i)) :
    Function.Injective (signPattern (K := K) root)

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.signPattern_eq_zero
decls.doc: The sign is `0` exactly where the automorphism fixes the generator.
decls.statement:
theorem signPattern_eq_zero
    (σ : adjoin K (Set.range root) ≃ₐ[K] adjoin K (Set.range root)) (i : ι)
    (h : σ (gen root i) = gen root i) : signPattern root σ i = 0

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.signPattern_eq_zero_iff
decls.doc: The sign is `0` iff the automorphism fixes the generator.
decls.statement:
theorem signPattern_eq_zero_iff
    (σ : adjoin K (Set.range root) ≃ₐ[K] adjoin K (Set.range root)) (i : ι) :
    signPattern root σ i = 0 ↔ σ (gen root i) = gen root i

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.signPattern_eq_one
decls.doc: The sign is `1` where the automorphism negates a generator that differs from its negation.
decls.statement:
theorem signPattern_eq_one
    (σ : adjoin K (Set.range root) ≃ₐ[K] adjoin K (Set.range root)) (i : ι)
    (hne : gen (K := K) root i ≠ -gen root i)
    (h : σ (gen root i) = -gen root i) : signPattern root σ i = 1

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.signPattern_eq_one_iff
decls.doc: The sign is `1` iff the automorphism negates a generator that differs from its negation.
decls.statement:
theorem signPattern_eq_one_iff (hroot : ∀ i, root i ^ 2 = algebraMap K L (d i))
    (σ : adjoin K (Set.range root) ≃ₐ[K] adjoin K (Set.range root)) (i : ι)
    (hne : gen (K := K) root i ≠ -gen root i) :
    signPattern root σ i = 1 ↔ σ (gen root i) = -gen root i

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.signPattern_one
decls.doc: The identity automorphism has the zero sign pattern.
decls.statement:
theorem signPattern_one : signPattern (K := K) root (1 : adjoin K (Set.range root) ≃ₐ[K]
    adjoin K (Set.range root)) = 0

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.signed_pow_add_mul
decls.statement:
theorem signed_pow_add_mul (x : adjoin K (Set.range root)) (a b : ZMod 2) :
    (-1 : adjoin K (Set.range root)) ^ b.val * ((-1) ^ a.val * x)
      = (-1) ^ (a + b).val * x

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.zmod_two_eq_zero_or_one
decls.statement: theorem zmod_two_eq_zero_or_one (t : ZMod 2) : t = 0 ∨ t = 1

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.aut_mul_gen_eq_signPattern_add
decls.statement:
theorem aut_mul_gen_eq_signPattern_add
    (hroot : ∀ i, root i ^ 2 = algebraMap K L (d i))
    (σ τ : adjoin K (Set.range root) ≃ₐ[K] adjoin K (Set.range root)) (i : ι) :
    (σ * τ) (gen root i)
      = (-1) ^ (signPattern root σ i + signPattern root τ i).val * gen root i

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.signPattern_mul_apply
decls.doc: Pointwise composition rule for sign patterns.
decls.statement:
theorem signPattern_mul_apply (hroot : ∀ i, root i ^ 2 = algebraMap K L (d i))
    (σ τ : adjoin K (Set.range root) ≃ₐ[K] adjoin K (Set.range root)) (i : ι) :
    signPattern root (σ * τ) i = signPattern root σ i + signPattern root τ i

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.signPattern_mul
decls.doc: The sign pattern is additive: it is a group homomorphism to `ι → ℤ/2`.
decls.statement:
theorem signPattern_mul (hroot : ∀ i, root i ^ 2 = algebraMap K L (d i))
    (σ τ : adjoin K (Set.range root) ≃ₐ[K] adjoin K (Set.range root)) :
    signPattern root (σ * τ) = signPattern root σ + signPattern root τ

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.signHom
decls.doc: The Galois group of `M / K` maps to the sign patterns `(ℤ/2)ⁱ`.

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.signHom_apply
decls.doc: Evaluation rule for `signHom`: it is the multiplicative form of `signPattern`.
decls.statement:
theorem signHom_apply (hroot : ∀ i, root i ^ 2 = algebraMap K L (d i))
    (σ : adjoin K (Set.range root) ≃ₐ[K] adjoin K (Set.range root)) :
    -- Applying the bundled `MonoidHom` unfolds to its `toFun`, which is `ofAdd ∘ signPattern`.
    signHom root hroot σ = Multiplicative.ofAdd (signPattern root σ)

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.signHom_injective
decls.doc: The sign-pattern homomorphism is injective.
decls.statement:
theorem signHom_injective (hroot : ∀ i, root i ^ 2 = algebraMap K L (d i)) :
    Function.Injective (signHom (K := K) root hroot)

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.signHom_bijective
decls.statement:
theorem signHom_bijective [Finite ι] [NeZero (2 : K)]
    (hroot : ∀ i, root i ^ 2 = algebraMap K L (d i))
    (hindep : ∀ S : Finset ι, S.Nonempty → ¬ IsSquare (∏ i ∈ S, d i)) :
    Function.Bijective (signHom (K := K) root hroot)

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.galoisGroupEquiv
decls.doc:
**For square-class independent radicands, the Galois group of a multiquadratic field is
`(ℤ/2)ⁿ`.**
decls.statement:
def galoisGroupEquiv [Finite ι] [NeZero (2 : K)]
    (hroot : ∀ i, root i ^ 2 = algebraMap K L (d i))
    (hindep : ∀ S : Finset ι, S.Nonempty → ¬ IsSquare (∏ i ∈ S, d i)) :
    (adjoin K (Set.range root) ≃ₐ[K] adjoin K (Set.range root)) ≃*
      Multiplicative (ι → ZMod 2)

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.aut_nontrivial
decls.doc:
**A multiquadratic field over a nonempty family of independent radicands has a nontrivial Galois
group.**
decls.statement:
theorem aut_nontrivial [Finite ι] [NeZero (2 : K)] [Nonempty ι]
    (hroot : ∀ i, root i ^ 2 = algebraMap K L (d i))
    (hindep : ∀ S : Finset ι, S.Nonempty → ¬ IsSquare (∏ i ∈ S, d i)) :
    Nontrivial (adjoin K (Set.range root) ≃ₐ[K] adjoin K (Set.range root))

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.galoisGroupEquiv_apply
decls.doc: The Galois-group equivalence sends an automorphism to its multiplicative sign pattern.
decls.statement:
theorem galoisGroupEquiv_apply [Finite ι] [NeZero (2 : K)]
    (hroot : ∀ i, root i ^ 2 = algebraMap K L (d i))
    (hindep : ∀ S : Finset ι, S.Nonempty → ¬ IsSquare (∏ i ∈ S, d i))
    (σ : adjoin K (Set.range root) ≃ₐ[K] adjoin K (Set.range root)) :
    galoisGroupEquiv hroot hindep σ = Multiplicative.ofAdd (signPattern root σ)

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.galoisGroupEquiv_symm_apply_gen
decls.doc:
The inverse of `galoisGroupEquiv` realizes a sign pattern `ε` as the automorphism sending each
generator `rootᵢ` to `(-1)^(εᵢ) · rootᵢ`.
decls.statement:
theorem galoisGroupEquiv_symm_apply_gen [Finite ι] [NeZero (2 : K)]
    (hroot : ∀ i, root i ^ 2 = algebraMap K L (d i))
    (hindep : ∀ S : Finset ι, S.Nonempty → ¬ IsSquare (∏ i ∈ S, d i))
    (ε : ι → ZMod 2) (i : ι) :
    ((galoisGroupEquiv hroot hindep).symm (Multiplicative.ofAdd ε)) (gen root i)
      = (-1) ^ (ε i).val * gen root i

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.card_aut_adjoin_range
decls.doc:
**Cardinality of the Galois group of a multiquadratic field.** If no nonempty subset product
of the radicands `d i` is a square in `K` (and `2 ≠ 0` in `K`), then the multiquadratic field
`M = K(rootᵢ : i)` has `|Gal(M/K)| = 2^|ι|`. This is the cardinality reading of the explicit
isomorphism `galoisGroupEquiv`.
decls.title: Cardinality of the Galois group of a multiquadratic field
decls.statement:
theorem card_aut_adjoin_range [Finite ι] [NeZero (2 : K)]
    (hroot : ∀ i, root i ^ 2 = algebraMap K L (d i))
    (hindep : ∀ S : Finset ι, S.Nonempty → ¬ IsSquare (∏ i ∈ S, d i)) :
    Nat.card (adjoin K (Set.range root) ≃ₐ[K] adjoin K (Set.range root)) = 2 ^ Nat.card ι

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.primeDiscriminant_eq_sq_mul_radicand
decls.doc: A prime discriminant is a nonzero square (`1` or `2²`) times its radicand.
decls.statement:
lemma primeDiscriminant_eq_sq_mul_radicand {P : ℤ} (hP : IsPrimeDiscriminant P) :
    ∃ c : ℤ, c ≠ 0 ∧ P = c ^ 2 * primeDiscriminantRadicand P

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.exists_mem_adjoin_sq_eq_of_prod_primeDiscriminant_eq
decls.doc:
**A square root of `d` in the prime-discriminant compositum.** Let `d : ℤ` and let `s` be a
finite set of prime discriminants whose product is the fundamental discriminant
`fundamentalDiscriminant d`. For any chosen square roots `root` of the radicands of the members of
`s` in a field `L` over `ℚ`, the compositum `adjoin ℚ (Set.range root)` contains an element
squaring to `d`. This is the square-class containment underlying the genus-field construction.
decls.title: A square root of `d` in the prime-discriminant compositum
decls.statement:
theorem exists_mem_adjoin_sq_eq_of_prod_primeDiscriminant_eq {d : ℤ} {s : Finset ℤ}
    (hs : ∀ P ∈ s, IsPrimeDiscriminant P) (hprod : ∏ P ∈ s, P = fundamentalDiscriminant d)
    {L : Type*} [Field L] [Algebra ℚ L] (root : {P // P ∈ s} → L)
    (hroot : ∀ P : {P // P ∈ s},
      root P ^ 2 = algebraMap ℚ L ((primeDiscriminantRadicand P.val : ℤ) : ℚ)) :
    ∃ x ∈ IntermediateField.adjoin ℚ (Set.range root), x ^ 2 = algebraMap ℚ L ((d : ℤ) : ℚ)

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.exists_finset_primeDiscriminant_and_exists_mem_adjoin_sq_eq_of_squarefree
decls.doc:
**The prime-discriminant compositum of a squarefree radicand contains a square root of `d`.**
For squarefree `d`, the fundamental discriminant `fundamentalDiscriminant d` factors into a finite
set `s` of prime discriminants, and for any roots of their radicands the compositum contains an
element squaring to `d`. This packages `exists_mem_adjoin_sq_eq_of_prod_primeDiscriminant_eq` with
the factorization `IsFundamentalDiscriminant.exists_finset_primeDiscriminant`, so callers need only
supply `d` squarefree.
decls.title: The prime-discriminant compositum of a squarefree radicand contains a square root of `d`
decls.statement:
theorem exists_finset_primeDiscriminant_and_exists_mem_adjoin_sq_eq_of_squarefree {d : ℤ}
    (hd : Squarefree d) :
    ∃ s : Finset ℤ, (∀ P ∈ s, IsPrimeDiscriminant P) ∧
      (∀ P ∈ s, ∀ Q ∈ s, IsEvenPrimeDiscriminant P → IsEvenPrimeDiscriminant Q → P = Q) ∧
      ∏ P ∈ s, P = fundamentalDiscriminant d ∧
      ∀ {L : Type*} [Field L] [Algebra ℚ L] (root : {P // P ∈ s} → L),
        (∀ P, root P ^ 2 = algebraMap ℚ L ((primeDiscriminantRadicand P.val : ℤ) : ℚ)) →
          ∃ x ∈ IntermediateField.adjoin ℚ (Set.range root), x ^ 2 = algebraMap ℚ L ((d : ℤ) : ℚ)

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.not_intCast_prime_dvd_two
decls.doc: If `q` is an odd natural prime, then it does not divide `2` as an integer.
decls.statement: theorem not_intCast_prime_dvd_two (hq : q ≠ 2) : ¬ (q : ℤ) ∣ (2 : ℤ)

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.legendreSym_evenPrimeDiscriminantRadicand
decls.doc:
The Legendre symbol of an even prime-discriminant radicand at an odd prime `q` is the
supplementary character attached to that discriminant: `χ₄ q` for `-4` (radicand `-1`),
`χ₈ q` for `8` (radicand `2`), and `χ₈' q` for `-8` (radicand `-2`).
decls.statement:
theorem legendreSym_evenPrimeDiscriminantRadicand {D : ℤ} (hD : IsEvenPrimeDiscriminant D)
    (hq : q ≠ 2) :
    legendreSym q (evenPrimeDiscriminantRadicand D) =
      if D = -4 then χ₄ q else if D = 8 then χ₈ q else χ₈' q

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.legendreSym_evenPrimeDiscriminant_eq_legendreSym_radicand
decls.doc:
An even prime discriminant `D` and its radicand `D / 4` have the same Legendre symbol at
every odd prime `q`: they differ by the square factor `4`, which contributes a trivial
symbol. This is the form used by the genus-field splitting law, where the prime discriminant
`D` itself is the splitting character.
decls.statement:
theorem legendreSym_evenPrimeDiscriminant_eq_legendreSym_radicand {D : ℤ}
    (hD : IsEvenPrimeDiscriminant D)
    (hq : q ≠ 2) :
    legendreSym q D = legendreSym q (evenPrimeDiscriminantRadicand D)

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.legendreSym_evenPrimeDiscriminantRadicand_neg_four_eq_one_iff
decls.doc:
The radicand `-1` of the prime discriminant `-4` is a quadratic residue modulo an odd
prime `q` exactly when `q ≡ 1 (mod 4)`; equivalently `q` splits in `ℚ(√-1) = ℚ(i)`.
decls.statement:
theorem legendreSym_evenPrimeDiscriminantRadicand_neg_four_eq_one_iff (hq : q ≠ 2) :
    legendreSym q (evenPrimeDiscriminantRadicand (-4)) = 1 ↔ q % 4 = 1

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.legendreSym_evenPrimeDiscriminantRadicand_eight_eq_one_iff
decls.doc:
The radicand `2` of the prime discriminant `8` is a quadratic residue modulo an odd
prime `q` exactly when `q ≡ 1` or `7 (mod 8)`; equivalently `q` splits in `ℚ(√2)`.
decls.statement:
theorem legendreSym_evenPrimeDiscriminantRadicand_eight_eq_one_iff (hq : q ≠ 2) :
    legendreSym q (evenPrimeDiscriminantRadicand 8) = 1 ↔ q % 8 = 1 ∨ q % 8 = 7

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.legendreSym_evenPrimeDiscriminantRadicand_neg_eight_eq_one_iff
decls.doc:
The radicand `-2` of the prime discriminant `-8` is a quadratic residue modulo an odd
prime `q` exactly when `q ≡ 1` or `3 (mod 8)`; equivalently `q` splits in `ℚ(√-2)`.
decls.statement:
theorem legendreSym_evenPrimeDiscriminantRadicand_neg_eight_eq_one_iff (hq : q ≠ 2) :
    legendreSym q (evenPrimeDiscriminantRadicand (-8)) = 1 ↔ q % 8 = 1 ∨ q % 8 = 3

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.legendreSym_evenPrimeDiscriminantRadicand_eq_one_iff
decls.doc:
The radicand of a variable even prime discriminant is a quadratic residue modulo an odd
prime `q` exactly under the corresponding supplementary congruence condition.
decls.statement:
theorem legendreSym_evenPrimeDiscriminantRadicand_eq_one_iff {D : ℤ}
    (hD : IsEvenPrimeDiscriminant D) (hq : q ≠ 2) :
    legendreSym q (evenPrimeDiscriminantRadicand D) = 1 ↔
      if D = -4 then q % 4 = 1
      else if D = 8 then q % 8 = 1 ∨ q % 8 = 7
      else q % 8 = 1 ∨ q % 8 = 3

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.legendreSym_evenPrimeDiscriminant_eq_one_iff
decls.doc:
A variable even prime discriminant is a quadratic residue modulo an odd prime `q`
exactly under the corresponding supplementary congruence condition.
decls.statement:
theorem legendreSym_evenPrimeDiscriminant_eq_one_iff {D : ℤ}
    (hD : IsEvenPrimeDiscriminant D) (hq : q ≠ 2) :
    legendreSym q D = 1 ↔
      if D = -4 then q % 4 = 1
      else if D = 8 then q % 8 = 1 ∨ q % 8 = 7
      else q % 8 = 1 ∨ q % 8 = 3

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.legendreSym_evenPrimeDiscriminant_neg_four_eq_one_iff
decls.doc:
The prime discriminant `-4` is a quadratic residue modulo an odd prime `q` exactly when
`q ≡ 1 (mod 4)`.
decls.statement:
theorem legendreSym_evenPrimeDiscriminant_neg_four_eq_one_iff (hq : q ≠ 2) :
    legendreSym q (-4) = 1 ↔ q % 4 = 1

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.legendreSym_evenPrimeDiscriminant_eight_eq_one_iff
decls.doc:
The prime discriminant `8` is a quadratic residue modulo an odd prime `q` exactly when
`q ≡ 1` or `7 (mod 8)`.
decls.statement:
theorem legendreSym_evenPrimeDiscriminant_eight_eq_one_iff (hq : q ≠ 2) :
    legendreSym q 8 = 1 ↔ q % 8 = 1 ∨ q % 8 = 7

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.legendreSym_evenPrimeDiscriminant_neg_eight_eq_one_iff
decls.doc:
The prime discriminant `-8` is a quadratic residue modulo an odd prime `q` exactly when
`q ≡ 1` or `3 (mod 8)`.
decls.statement:
theorem legendreSym_evenPrimeDiscriminant_neg_eight_eq_one_iff (hq : q ≠ 2) :
    legendreSym q (-8) = 1 ↔ q % 8 = 1 ∨ q % 8 = 3

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.legendreSym_oddPrimeDiscriminant
decls.doc:
Expanding the Legendre symbol of the odd prime discriminant `p*`. This version does not
assume `q` is odd: in the negative case it leaves the factor `legendreSym q (-1)` explicit.

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.legendreSym_oddPrimeDiscriminant_of_ne_two
decls.doc:
Expanding the Legendre symbol of `p*` at an odd prime `q`, using the supplementary law
`legendreSym q (-1) = χ₄ q`.

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.legendreSym_oddPrimeDiscriminant_eq_legendreSym
decls.doc:
For odd primes `p` and `q`, the Legendre symbol of the odd prime discriminant `p*` at
`q` is the reciprocal symbol `(q / p)`. This is the prime-discriminant form of quadratic
reciprocity used by genus-field splitting criteria.
decls.statement:
theorem legendreSym_oddPrimeDiscriminant_eq_legendreSym [Fact p.Prime] [Fact q.Prime]
    (hp : p ≠ 2) (hq : q ≠ 2) :
    legendreSym q (oddPrimeDiscriminant p) = legendreSym p (q : ℤ)

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.legendreSym_oddPrimeDiscriminant_eq_one_iff
decls.doc:
The quadratic-residue condition for the odd prime discriminant `p*` can be read as the
reciprocal Legendre symbol `(q / p) = 1`. This is the form consumed by the multiquadratic
prime-splitting law after the genus-field radicands have been normalized to prime
discriminants.
decls.statement:
theorem legendreSym_oddPrimeDiscriminant_eq_one_iff [Fact p.Prime] [Fact q.Prime]
    (hp : p ≠ 2) (hq : q ≠ 2) :
    legendreSym q (oddPrimeDiscriminant p) = 1 ↔ legendreSym p (q : ℤ) = 1

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.forall_legendreSym_oddPrimeDiscriminant_eq_one_iff
decls.doc:
Family form of `legendreSym_oddPrimeDiscriminant_eq_one_iff`: for a family of odd primes
`p i`, the conditions that all odd prime discriminants `p i*` are quadratic residues modulo
an odd prime `q` are exactly the reciprocal conditions `(q / p i) = 1`.
decls.statement:
theorem forall_legendreSym_oddPrimeDiscriminant_eq_one_iff {ι : Type*} (p : ι → ℕ)
    {q : ℕ} [Fact q.Prime] (hpprime : ∀ i, (p i).Prime) (hpodd : ∀ i, p i ≠ 2)
    (hq : q ≠ 2) :
    (∀ i, legendreSym q (oddPrimeDiscriminant (p i)) = 1) ↔
      ∀ i, @legendreSym (p i) ⟨hpprime i⟩ (q : ℤ) = 1

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.forall_legendreSym_neg_four_five_eq_one_iff
decls.doc:
**The `ℚ(√-5)` genus-field character condition.** For an odd prime `p`, the Legendre
symbols of the prime-discriminant list `[-4, 5]` are all `1` exactly when
`p ≡ 1 (mod 4)` and the reciprocal symbol `(p / 5)` is `1`.
decls.title: The `ℚ(√-5)` genus-field character condition
decls.statement:
theorem forall_legendreSym_neg_four_five_eq_one_iff {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] (hodd : p ≠ 2) :
    (∀ i, legendreSym p (negFourFivePrimeDiscriminants i) = 1) ↔
      p % 4 = 1 ∧ @legendreSym 5 ⟨by decide⟩ (p : ℤ) = 1

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.forall_legendreSym_neg_four_neg_three_neg_seven_eq_one_iff
decls.doc:
**The `ℚ(√-21)` genus-field character condition.** For an odd prime `p`, the Legendre
symbols of the prime-discriminant list `[-4, -3, -7]` are all `1` exactly when
`p ≡ 1 (mod 4)`, `(p / 3) = 1`, and `(p / 7) = 1`.
decls.title: The `ℚ(√-21)` genus-field character condition

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.legendreSym_eq_legendreSym_primeDiscriminantRadicand
decls.doc:
An integer `D` and its associated prime-discriminant radicand have the same Legendre symbol
at an odd prime `q`. Away from the three even prime discriminants this is just the radicand
definition; in the even-prime cases the two values differ by the square factor `4`.
decls.statement:
theorem legendreSym_eq_legendreSym_primeDiscriminantRadicand (D : ℤ) (hq : q ≠ 2) :
    legendreSym q D = legendreSym q (primeDiscriminantRadicand D)

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.forall_legendreSym_primeDiscriminant_eq_one_iff_radicand
decls.doc:
Family form of
`legendreSym_eq_legendreSym_primeDiscriminantRadicand`: the condition that all integers in a
family are quadratic residues modulo an odd prime `q` is equivalent to the same condition on
their associated squarefree radicands. This is the conversion used before applying the
multiquadratic splitting law to genus-field prime discriminants.
decls.statement:
theorem forall_legendreSym_primeDiscriminant_eq_one_iff_radicand {ι : Type*} (D : ι → ℤ)
    (hq : q ≠ 2) :
    (∀ i, legendreSym q (D i) = 1) ↔
      ∀ i, legendreSym q (primeDiscriminantRadicand (D i)) = 1

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.legendreSym_primeDiscriminant_eq_one_iff
decls.doc:
The uniform quadratic-residue criterion for a prime discriminant `D` at an odd prime `q`.
For the three even prime discriminants this is the corresponding supplementary congruence
condition on `q`; for an odd prime discriminant `p*` it is the reciprocal condition
`(q / p) = 1`.
decls.statement:
theorem legendreSym_primeDiscriminant_eq_one_iff {D : ℤ}
    (hD : IsPrimeDiscriminant D) (hq : q ≠ 2) :
    legendreSym q D = 1 ↔
      (IsEvenPrimeDiscriminant D ∧
        (if D = -4 then q % 4 = 1
        else if D = 8 then q % 8 = 1 ∨ q % 8 = 7
        else q % 8 = 1 ∨ q % 8 = 3)) ∨
      ∃ p : ℕ, ∃ hp : p.Prime, Odd p ∧ D = oddPrimeDiscriminant p ∧
        @legendreSym p ⟨hp⟩ (q : ℤ) = 1

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.legendreSym_primeDiscriminantRadicand_eq_one_iff
decls.doc:
The same uniform quadratic-residue criterion as
`legendreSym_primeDiscriminant_eq_one_iff`, stated for the associated squarefree radicand.
This is the form consumed after converting a genus-field prime-discriminant list into
multiquadratic radicands.
decls.statement:
theorem legendreSym_primeDiscriminantRadicand_eq_one_iff {D : ℤ}
    (hD : IsPrimeDiscriminant D) (hq : q ≠ 2) :
    legendreSym q (primeDiscriminantRadicand D) = 1 ↔
      (IsEvenPrimeDiscriminant D ∧
        (if D = -4 then q % 4 = 1
        else if D = 8 then q % 8 = 1 ∨ q % 8 = 7
        else q % 8 = 1 ∨ q % 8 = 3)) ∨
      ∃ p : ℕ, ∃ hp : p.Prime, Odd p ∧ D = oddPrimeDiscriminant p ∧
        @legendreSym p ⟨hp⟩ (q : ℤ) = 1

decls.name: TauCeti.Multiquadratic.forall_legendreSym_primeDiscriminant_eq_one_iff
decls.doc: Indexed-family form of the uniform prime-discriminant residue criterion.
decls.statement:
theorem forall_legendreSym_primeDiscriminant_eq_one_iff {ι : Type*} (D : ι → ℤ)
    (hD : ∀ i, IsPrimeDiscriminant (D i)) (hq : q ≠ 2) :
    (∀ i, legendreSym q (D i) = 1) ↔
      ∀ i,
        (IsEvenPrimeDiscriminant (D i) ∧
          (if D i = -4 then q % 4 = 1
          else if D i = 8 then q % 8 = 1 ∨ q % 8 = 7
          else q % 8 = 1 ∨ q % 8 = 3)) ∨
        ∃ p : ℕ, ∃ hp : p.Prime, Odd p ∧ D i = oddPrimeDiscriminant p ∧
          @legendreSym p ⟨hp⟩ (q : ℤ) = 1

decls.title: Worked example: `[ℚ(i, √-3, √-7) : ℚ] = 8`

      (adjoin ℚ ({Complex.I, sqrtNegThree, sqrtNegSeven} : Set ℂ) : IntermediateField ℚ ℂ)

multiquadratic field `ℚ(√-1, √-3, √-7)` attached to the prime discriminants `-4`, `-3`,

decls.title: Worked example: `|Gal(ℚ(i, √-3, √-7)/ℚ)| = 8`

theorem card_aut_adjoin_I_sqrt_neg_three_sqrt_neg_seven :
    Nat.card

          IntermediateField ℚ ℂ)
          ≃ₐ[ℚ]
        (adjoin ℚ ({Complex.I, sqrtNegThree, sqrtNegSeven} : Set ℂ) :

decls.name: TauCeti.NumberField.legendreSym_eq_one_of_ncard_primesOver_eq_finrank
decls.doc:
Forward direction (pointwise): for `K` Galois over `ℚ`, if `p` splits completely
(`#{primes over p} = [K : ℚ]`) and `p ∤ d i`, then `d i` is a quadratic residue mod `p`.
decls.statement:
theorem legendreSym_eq_one_of_ncard_primesOver_eq_finrank {ι : Type*} (d : ι → ℤ)
    (r : ι → K) (hr : ∀ i, r i ^ 2 = algebraMap ℤ K (d i)) [IsGalois ℚ K]
    {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] {i : ι} (hcop_i : ¬ (p : ℤ) ∣ d i)
    (Q : Ideal (𝓞 K)) [Q.IsPrime] [Q.LiesOver (span {(p : ℤ)})]
    (hsplit : (primesOver (span {(p : ℤ)}) (𝓞 K)).ncard = finrank ℚ K) :
    legendreSym p (d i) = 1

decls.name: TauCeti.NumberField.exists_dvd_sq_sub_and_not_dvd_of_legendreSym_eq_one
decls.doc:
A nonzero quadratic residue `d` mod a prime `p` (`legendreSym p d = 1`, `p ∤ d`) has an integer
square root modulo `p`: some `a` with `p ∣ a² - d` and `p ∤ a`.
decls.statement:
theorem exists_dvd_sq_sub_and_not_dvd_of_legendreSym_eq_one (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]
    {d : ℤ} (hqr : legendreSym p d = 1) :
    ∃ a : ℤ, (p : ℤ) ∣ a ^ 2 - d ∧ ¬ (p : ℤ) ∣ a

decls.name: TauCeti.NumberField.two_mul_mem_of_mul_mem_of_map_eq_neg
decls.doc:
If a prime ideal `Q` of a ring contains a product `(R - A)(R + A)`, and an additive map
preserving `Q` sends `R` to `-R` and fixes `A`, then `2A ∈ Q`.

decls.name: TauCeti.NumberField.map_ne_neg_of_legendreSym_eq_one
decls.doc:
If `d` is a quadratic residue mod the odd prime `p` (with `p ∤ d`), no element `σ` of the
decomposition group of a prime `Q` above `p` sends the generator `r` to its negation.
decls.statement:
theorem map_ne_neg_of_legendreSym_eq_one (d : ℤ) (r : K)
    (hr : r ^ 2 = algebraMap ℤ K d)
    {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] (hodd : p ≠ 2)
    (hqr : legendreSym p d = 1)
    (Q : Ideal (𝓞 K)) [Q.IsPrime] [Q.LiesOver (span {(p : ℤ)})]
    {σ : K ≃ₐ[ℚ] K} (hσ : σ ∈ stabilizer (K ≃ₐ[ℚ] K) Q) : σ r ≠ - r

decls.name: TauCeti.NumberField.decompositionGroup_fixes_gen
decls.doc:
Backward core (pointwise): if `p` is odd and `d` is a quadratic residue mod `p`, then every
`σ` in the decomposition group of `Q` fixes the generator `r`.
decls.statement:
theorem decompositionGroup_fixes_gen (d : ℤ) (r : K)
    (hr : r ^ 2 = algebraMap ℤ K d)
    {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] (hodd : p ≠ 2)
    (hqr : legendreSym p d = 1)
    (Q : Ideal (𝓞 K)) [Q.IsPrime] [Q.LiesOver (span {(p : ℤ)})]
    {σ : K ≃ₐ[ℚ] K} (hσ : σ ∈ stabilizer (K ≃ₐ[ℚ] K) Q) : σ r = r

decls.name: TauCeti.NumberField.stabilizer_eq_bot_of_forall_legendreSym_eq_one
decls.doc:
Backward wrapper: for `K` generated over `ℚ` by the `r i` (`ℚ(rᵢ) = K`), if `p` is odd and
every `d i` is a quadratic residue mod `p`, then the decomposition group of `Q` is trivial.
decls.statement:
